segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus stood before the crowd and described two roads — two ways that every person gets to choose.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: One road looks easy. The gate is wide, the path is broad, and a lot of people walk that way.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The other road looks harder. The gate is narrow, the path is tight, and far fewer find it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He wasn't describing geography. He was describing a decision.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A narrow gate that leads to life, found by the few who choose it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He never said the narrow way would be crowded. He said it leads to life. Both gates are standing open right now, and nobody walks through either one by accident.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There are two gates, and one choice. He said the narrow way is worth finding. Step through.
